en: Black‑and‑white vintage image showing a group of World War I–era soldiers walking arm‑in‑arm with young women in regional folk costumes along a narrow city street lined with buildings and flags. The mood appears festive, as if celebrating liberation or a victory parade. The scene is photographed from the front, capturing several passersby and hanging flags high above the street.
